answer_2.quote: We first measure functional correctness using an automated unit test framework... we compute the unit test accuracy as the fraction of problems for which all associated test cases pass.

answer_3.quote: We present both the model-generated function and the reference solution to the LLM judge and evaluate the generated code from two distinct but complementary perspectives: algorithmic logic correctness and implementation correctness.

answer_4.quote: We also include detailed human annotation (Appendix B). Human evaluation with LLM-as-a-judge shows the worst performance, and annotators provide justifications for their scoring.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are provided with uniform evaluation criteria and asked to write a brief justification of their scoring.
